E02.smt: (define-fun spec ((amt Int) (v Int)) Bool (=> (> amt 1000) (= v 1)))

E04.smt: (define-fun spec ((sev Int) (h Int)) Bool (and (=> (= sev 3) (<= h 24)) (=> (= sev 2) (<= h 168)) (=> (= sev 1) (<= h 720))))

E05.smt: (define-fun spec ((age Int) (ttl Int) (skew Int)) Bool (and (<= age ttl) (<= skew 5)))
E05.ambiguity: yes: 'within the TTL' read as inclusive (age <= ttl); strict age < ttl is the other common TTL convention

E06.smt: (define-fun spec ((pool Int) (reserve Int) (epoch Int) (stale Int)) Bool (and (= pool 2) (= reserve 1) (<= epoch 4) (<= stale 1)))
E06.ambiguity: yes: bare 'pool 2' and 'reserve 1' read as exact values, because the same list marks upper bounds explicitly for the other two; under the 'Bounds' heading they could instead mean pool <= 2 and reserve <= 1

E07.smt: (define-fun spec ((lat Int) (c Int)) Bool (=> (> lat 200) (= c 1)))
E07.ambiguity: yes: 'if' read as one-way implication, not iff; formalised literally although committing on high latency looks inverted from the likely intent (abort)

E08.smt: (define-fun spec ((b Int) (r Int)) Bool (and (= b 0) (<= r 300)))

E09.ambiguity: yes: '5 retries' read as excluding the first try, so attempts <= 6; if it means 5 tries in total the bound is 5

E10.smt: (define-fun spec ((t Int) (p Int)) Bool (=> (>= t 4) (= p 1)))
E10.ambiguity: yes: boundary at t = 4 read as triggering (4 whole hours elapsed with no acknowledgement); the alternative is t > 4

K0.smt: (define-fun spec ((C Int) (q1 Int) (q2 Int) (q3 Int)) Bool (<= (+ q1 q2 q3) C))

K1.smt: (define-fun spec ((C Int) (q1 Int) (q2 Int) (q3 Int)) Bool (and (<= q1 C) (<= (+ q1 q2) C) (<= (+ q1 q2 q3) C)))
K1.ambiguity: yes: 'never' read as holding after each request in order (every prefix sum <= C), with negative amounts giving capacity back since nothing says otherwise; alternatives are the final sum only, or negatives restoring nothing as in K2/K3

K2.smt: (define-fun spec ((C Int) (q1 Int) (q2 Int) (q3 Int)) Bool (<= (+ (ite (> q1 0) q1 0) (ite (> q2 0) q2 0) (ite (> q3 0) q3 0)) C))

K3.smt: (define-fun spec ((C Int) (q1 Int) (q2 Int) (q3 Int)) Bool (<= (+ (ite (> q1 0) q1 0) (ite (> q2 0) q2 0) (ite (> q3 0) q3 0)) C))

K4.smt: (define-fun spec ((C Int) (q1 Int) (q2 Int) (q3 Int)) Bool (<= (+ q1 q2 q3) C))
